'''Kurihara Shrine''' (栗原神社) refers to several Shinto shrines in Japan:

* {{ill|Kurihara Shrine (Zama)|ja|栗原神社 (座間市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kurihara Shrine (Zama)|qq=}} - Located in Kurihara-Chūō, Zama City, Kanagawa Prefecture.
* {{ill|Kurihara Shrine (Takayama)|ja|栗原神社 (高山市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kurihara Shrine (Takayama)|qq=}} - Located in Kamitakara, Takayama City, Gifu Prefecture.
* {{ill|Kurihara Shrine (Higashiōsaka)|ja|栗原神社 (東大阪市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kurihara Shrine (Higashiōsaka)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Located in Yoshihara, Higashiōsaka City, Osaka Prefecture.
* {{ill|Kurihara Shrine (Maniwa)|ja|栗原神社 (真庭市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kurihara Shrine (Maniwa)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Located in Kurihara, Maniwa City, Okayama Prefecture.
